sources.title: NVIDIA H100 SXM5 80 GB Specs | TechPowerUp GPU Database
sources.snippet: The H100 SXM5 80 GB was a data center GPU by NVIDIA, launched in October 2022. Built on the 5 nm process, and based on the GH100 graphics processor, in its GH100-885KK-A1 variant, the GPU is not designed for gaming: it offers no DirectX support and targets AI and HPC workloads instead. Software support is provided through OpenCL 3.0 and CUDA 9.0.
